name: vitalens
description: VitaLens — AI Health Report Analysis & Doctor Recommendation System

scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,MOBILE,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:mobile" "npm run start:admin"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,MOBILE,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:mobile" "npm run start:admin"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n "BACKEND,MOBILE-WEB" -c "blue,green" "npm run start:backend" "cd mobile && npx expo start --web"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ANDROID" -c "blue,green" "npm run start:backend" "cd mobile && npx expo start --android"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -n "BACKEND,IOS" -c "blue,green" "npm run start:backend" "cd mobile && npx expo start --ios"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix mobile && npm install --prefix admin-web && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.check:types: npm run ts:check --prefix mobile && npm run build --prefix admin-web

author: Uzair Shaikh
